name: 1: 14-day QP and census date reached; retain earnings
description: Same as AC1 but the apprenticeship starts on the 25th of the month, so the 14-day qualifying window spans April into May. Pause is recorded on exactly day 14 (2026-05-08), which meets the threshold — earnings should be retained. Tests correct day counting across a month boundary. Covers FLP-1424 AC1.
